mapper.select: SELECT id, change_code, initiation_id, change_type, change_title, change_reason, change_desc, budget_impact, contract_impact, schedule_impact_days, profit_impact, profit_impact_pct, risk_level_after, affected_wbs_count, affected_staff_count, major_flag, approver_roles, applicant_id, applicant_name, contract_id, workflow_id, status, submitted_at, approved_at, executed_at, remark, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_project_change WHERE change_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pmis_project_change SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, change_code, initiation_id, change_type, change_title, change_reason, change_desc, budget_impact, contract_impact, schedule_impact_days, profit_impact, profit_impact_pct, risk_level_after, affected_wbs_count, affected_staff_count, major_flag, approver_roles, applicant_id, applicant_name, contract_id, workflow_id, status, submitted_at, approved_at, executed_at, remark, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_project_change WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC
